verdict.rationale: Statsig ships an official CLI (statsigcli) documented for managing Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs, and explicitly supports CI/CD pipeline integration for automation — a hallmark of agentic/AI-native workflows. This is corroborated by a separate probe confirming the CLI's dedicated docs page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reviews of the CLI and deeper documentation of AI-specific CLI usage patterns beyond CI/CD automation.
